_comment: SUPPLY-001: accepted dependency advisories. Each entry suppresses a finding from the CI dependency-audit gate (scripts/security/dependency-audit.mjs). Add an entry ONLY with a documented reason and a review date; re-evaluate on each audit. `id` matches an advisory URL, GHSA/CVE id, or a package name to accept all of its advisories.
_policy: List advisories individually, never by bare package name. Accepting a package accepts everything published against it in future, including an advisory nobody has read yet.

advisories.reason: Path traversal in the dev server's optimized-deps `.map` handling. This repository ships a static `vite build`; the dev server runs on a developer's own machine and is never exposed. The only fix is vite 8 — a major bump of the build toolchain, which is its own change with its own regression surface.

`server.fs.deny` bypass via Windows alternate path forms. Dev-server only, and no part of this project's build or deployment runs on Windows. Same fix, and same major-bump argument, as GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9.

launch-editor discloses an NTLMv2 hash through UNC path handling on Windows. Reachable only through the dev server's open-in-editor overlay, on Windows. Same fix, and same major-bump argument, as GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9.

Prototype pollution in SheetJS. `npm audit` reports no fixed version because SheetJS stopped publishing to the npm registry after 0.18 — the patched releases exist only on the vendor's own CDN, so there is no upgrade path from here. Accepted rather than ignored: the real remediation is to drop the dependency, and `exceljs` is already in this project and does the same work.
Regular-expression denial of service in SheetJS. Same absent upgrade path, and same remediation, as GHSA-4r6h-8v6p-xvw6.

Infinite loop in the ICNS parser, reached only through pptxgenjs, whose only call site is src/lib/reportTemplate/pptxExporter.ts. That runs in the browser, on a PowerPoint export the user themselves started, over images from their own template — so the worst case is that user hanging their own tab, not a server-side denial of service. The only fix is pptxgenjs 1.x, a major bump of the deck exporter, which is its own change with its own regression surface. Same argument as the vite entries below.
Infinite loop in the JXL and HEIF parsers. Same reachability and the same fix as GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr: browser-side, user-initiated, requires the pptxgenjs 1.x major bump.

Stack exhaustion when braces expands a deeply nested pattern. Every published version is affected (the range is <=3.0.3 and 3.0.3 is the latest), so there is nothing to upgrade to. braces is reached only through tailwindcss (via chokidar and micromatch), which runs at build time and expands the content globs in this repository's own tailwind.config.ts. No pattern from a user, a request or a stored row reaches it, nothing in src/ imports it, and it is not in the shipped bundle. The other packages the gate names (tailwindcss, @tailwindcss/typography, tailwindcss-animate, lovable-tagger, chokidar, fast-glob, micromatch) are flagged only through braces and need no entries. Re-evaluate as soon as braces publishes a fixed release.
